Hi Samantha / Jordan 

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps: 

Key needs we heard:
- You need a deployment model that supports PHI and allows us to sign a BAA.
- SOC2 Type II evidence will need to be shared with your security team for the vendor assessment.
- Preference expressed for network isolation (VPC) and customer-managed keys if possible.
- Timeline: security assessment early Aug, POC in mid-August if we align.

High-level mapping of Redwood options:
- Hosted API: fastest to get started but not intended for storing PHI and not appropriate for BAA-based HIPAA workloads.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): provides data isolation within dedicated GPU pools and is commonly used with BAAs; good tradeoff for predictable throughput and lower operational overhead versus on-prem.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): recommended for the strictest compliance needs (HIPAA), gives you customer-managed VPC, KMS/HSM integration, and full control for audit purposes.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will share our SOC2 summary and a HIPAA/BAA overview (attached).
2) Schedule a 45-min security deep dive with our security lead and solutions engineer  suggested slots Wed/Thu next week.
3) Share a deployment comparison table that outlines tradeoffs (latency, cost, isolation) so you can align with procurement/security.

Attachments: deployment-comparison-table.xlsx

If that looks right, can you confirm the items your security team must see (SOC2 PDF, BAA template, encryption details, audit logs)? Also please confirm your preferred time for the deep-dive call.

Subject: RE: Follow-up: Deployment options & HIPAA/SOC2 requirements  POC/tech notes

Hi Samantha  following up with technical clarifications for POC scoping.

Dedicated (recommended for initial POC):
- Isolation: dedicated GPU pools with tenant-level data separation.
- Networking: private subnets, static egress IP ranges, and optional VPC peering.
- Keys: supports customer KMS for encryption at rest.
- Typical performance: expect single-instance latencies similar to hosted API; throughput scales with pool size. We'll size the pool based on your target concurrency.

Private VPC / On-prem (recommended for full HIPAA):
- Provides VPC peering or air-gapped deployment.
- Full audit and log access; customer retains keys and logs.
- Setup window: usually 1-2 weeks for VPC peering + routing + KMS setup (depends on customer network approvals).

Cost/latency tradeoffs: Dedicated gives faster time-to-POC and lower integration overhead. Private/VPC gives stronger controls with slightly higher setup time and potentially higher monthly fixed cost.

Proposed POC plan:
- 2-week Dedicated POC to validate model outputs, latency, and integrations (can be bumped to Private if you need full key custody during POC).
- We will ask for expected concurrent requests and typical sequence length to properly size GPU pool  can you share an estimate?
- Proposed deep-dive slot: Thu 23 Jul 2026 14:00 PT (or suggest another time).

Attachments: deployment-comparison-table.xlsx (same sheet for quick reference)

Thanks
